sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 2020
ACT III OF 2020
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA LISSAAIL-E-WAL MAHROOM
FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019
An Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Lissaail-e-Wal Mahroom Foundation Act, 2015
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary,
13th January, 2020]
No.
PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills-54 / 2020/802, dated 13.1.2020.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Lissaail-e-Wal Mahroom
Foundation (Amendment) Bill, 2019 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 30th December. 2019 and assented to by the Governor of
the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 8th January, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS,
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Lissaail-e-Wal Mahroom
Foundation Act, 2015 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXVI of 2015) for the purpose
hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Lissaail-e-Wal Mahroom Foundation
(Amendment) Act, 2019.
(2) It
shall come into Force at once.

2. Amendment
of section 11 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No.XXVI of 2015.---In the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Lissail-e-Wal Mahroom
Foundation Act, 2015 (Act No. XXVI of 2015), in section 11, for subsection (1),
the following shall be substituted, namely:
"(1)
There shall be a Managing Director of the Foundation, who shall be posted by
Government from amongst the Officers in BPS-20 and above from
PAS/PMS/PCS.".
